title: Dissolution and nucleation of jump discontinuities for one-dimensional periodic peridynamic waves
summary: We analyze solutions to a one-dimensional periodic linear model for peridynamic waves, focusing on the setting where the natural energy space allows for spatial discontinuities. Exploiting the high-frequency asymptotics of the peridynamic dispersion relation, we construct an explicit solution whose initial displacement has a single jump discontinuity but becomes continuous at every positive time.
